diagnostics.name: Backend verifier

items.text: The Central Bank of the Islamic Republic announced it will use intervention tools to manage currency market fluctuations. The institution monitors currency market developments and will act if necessary to maintain monetary and currency stability. It will also take necessary measures to prevent non-fundamental trends in the market.

At least 140 people were arrested during protests in Bojnord between January 3 and 10, 2026. The number of detainees reached 180 by the end of January. Some of those arrested included a former judiciary employee and a nurse.

Pete Hegseth, the US War Secretary, announced in his speech at Quantico military base that Elon Musk is once again officially returning to President Donald Trump's advisory team. He added that Musk, together with Palmer Luckey, a founder of defense technology company Anduril, and Newt Gingrich, former Republican Speaker of the US House of Representatives, will lead 'Project Merdin'. The Pentagon has described the project as a 'study on the future of war'.

Mohammad Reza Naqdi, advisor to the commander of the IRGC, stated in a ceremony in Alborz province that Americans must leave the region or face the resistance of regional nations. He referred to the fate of American forces in Afghanistan and Iraq and warned that the same fate awaits US troops in Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Jordan, and Qatar. Naqdi also said that the nations of the region and the world are ready to rise against oppressors.

Iran International published an investigative report about the infiltration of an Israeli espionage network in Iran. Mehdi Naderi Jahromi was connected to a network linked to Mossad and had access to banking and telecommunications networks through his business activities. The report examines the details of this infiltration and the use of banking and telecommunications access.

A viewer stated in a video that many medical centers have canceled their contracts with supplementary insurance due to non-payment. The citizen said that paying for supplementary insurance has become useless.

Hosseinali Hajideligani, the representative of Shahin Shahr, said that the UAE should be occupied to prevent attacks on Iran. He emphasized that the UAE frequently threatens Iran and that Iran should be stationed there to ensure regional security. Hajideligani added that Iran was not the initiator of the war and has the right to act for its own security.

The US Treasury Secretary says Iran did not load a single crude oil shipment in September. Data from tanker tracking companies also shows no crude oil loadings from Iranian ports were recorded this month. Scott Bessent, the Treasury Secretary, wrote on X that the Trump administration is cutting off the Islamic Republic's most vital source of revenue.

Tasnim news agency reported an armed clash between the IRGC and members of a terrorist group in a village in Rask county. IRGC forces are clearing the area and assessing the situation. Fars news agency also reported the start of an IRGC operation in Rask from Friday morning.

Masoud Pezeshkian mentioned a six-member team in the Iranian government that has the authority to make decisions regarding the crisis with the US. The team mainly includes the president, the speaker of parliament, the secretary of the Supreme National Security Council, the chief of staff of the armed forces, and the commander of the IRGC, with the sixth member varying. Abbas Araghchi had previously spoken about a six-member committee involved in negotiations with the US, operating under the Supreme National Security Council.

The Iran Square in Buenos Aires, featuring a 19-meter column inspired by Persepolis, symbolizes the friendship between Iran and Argentina during the Pahlavi era. Years later, the name of the Islamic Republic became associated with the bombing of the AMIA Jewish center, resulting in 85 deaths. Alireza Mohbi, a reporter from Iran International, reports on the changing relationship between Iran and Argentina over time.

People have shared their experiences regarding the risks of changing jobs in Iran's current economic and social conditions. Some are seeking second jobs due to lack of job prospects and financial difficulties, while others have become unemployed due to layoffs. The uncertain future and tough job market conditions have made many afraid to change jobs and take risks.

Morteza Kazemian said that the emphasis of the Islamic Republic officials on confronting opponents and warning about civil war indicates the government's concern about new protests. He added that the government is preparing mosques and local bases to suppress protesters amid increasing economic pressure and social dissatisfaction.

The police commander of Rasht reported an attack on a cleric with a cold weapon by an unknown individual. The incident occurred in the Hafezabad neighborhood of Rasht after noon and afternoon prayers. The cleric's physical condition is currently stable.

Donald Trump posted a video of the nationwide protests in Iran in December on the Truth Social network. This video had previously been shared on December 31, 2025, by several Arabic accounts and accounts linked to a political organization abroad. Some doubted that the video was related to the 1401 (2022) protests.

The Portuguese Football Federation is trying to diplomatically resolve the tension between Cristiano Ronaldo and the national team coach, Jorge Jesus. A meeting with Ronaldo's consent is scheduled for next week to mend relations. The federation aims to end Ronaldo's national career with respect and dignity.
A video shows graffiti with the slogan "Long live the king" in the city of Nishapur. This video was received by Iran International. The graffiti in this city has attracted attention.

Iran won two gold medals in freestyle wrestling on the first day of the Asian Games in Nagoya. Mohammad Nokhodi won the first gold for Iranian freestyle wrestlers. Amirhossein Zare defeated China to become the heavyweight champion.

Iran's judo team did not win any medals at the Nagoya Asian Games. Maryam Barbate and Amirabbas Choupan both failed to reach the podium. An interview was conducted with Mohammad Mansouri, the head coach of Iran's team at the 2018 Asian Games.

Morteza Mousavi Jajarmi, the Friday prayer leader of Bojnord, said that if hijab is not observed in private, the law does not intervene, but in society, the law must act to maintain order and cleanliness. He emphasized that all countries have laws regarding social issues including dress code. The purpose of the law is to maintain order and discipline in society.

Emmanuel Macron announced that G7 leaders agreed to release up to 100 million barrels from strategic oil reserves over four months. This action will be carried out with the participation of G7 partners and coordination with the International Energy Agency. Additionally, refinery production capacity will be increased and there will be no restrictions on energy exchange among partner countries.

Ehsan Haddadi, head of the Athletics Federation, described some female athletes in this sport as "virtual athletes." Farzaneh Fasihi, an Iranian Olympic runner, responded by calling Haddadi "the most infamous athlete in Iran's history." This issue arose concurrently with the Asian Games.

Elnaz Shakerdoost was sentenced to one year in prison and two years of political, virtual, and artistic activity bans for supporting the December protests. This sentence was confirmed by the Tehran Province Court of Appeals. She is a cinema and television actress.

Rising living and rehabilitation equipment costs have made meeting daily needs harder for people with disabilities. Some Iran International viewers reported delays or cuts in pensions, nursing fees, and hygiene aid payments. These details were reported by Saba Heydarkhani.

Reuters reported that Tehran is preparing a stronger and broader response if the US resumes extensive attacks. Plans include expanding targets to countries supporting US military operations, possibly beyond the Middle East. The Islamic Republic is keeping negotiations open but considers the chance of an agreement low.

Iran won three gold medals in fencing at the 1974 Asian Games in Tehran. The Iranian women's foil team won the first gold medal for Iranian women in an international competition. Giti Mohban also won an individual bronze medal in addition to the team gold.

Four years after the "Woman, Life, Freedom" movement, a memorial ceremony for Nika Shakarami was held in Germany. The ceremony coincided with her birthday and the anniversary of her burial. Nika's mother, Nasrin Shakarami, attended the event.

Saghar Moradi became the first Iranian woman to win a gold medal in taekwondo at the Asian Games. Several other Iranian representatives in men's and women's categories did not reach the final stages. An interview was conducted with Davood Mimandi, a sports expert.

A group of Iranians living in Spain held a protest in Madrid on Friday, October 2nd. The protest was against executions by the Islamic Republic. Videos of the protest were received by Iran International.

Ali Shirazi, head of the ideological-political organization of the police, emphasized the importance of strengthening prayer, virtue, and hijab in the Islamic society. He called on officials, armed forces, and people to stand against immorality. He also stated that the armed forces, especially the Revolutionary Guards, have made significant advances in the recent war.

On the thirteenth day of the 2026 Asian Games in Nagoya, the Iranian team won three gold medals. Mohammad Nokhodi and Amirhossein Zare won gold in freestyle wrestling, and Saghar Moradi won gold in taekwondo. The total number of Iran's gold medals reached 15.

The Iraqi Prime Minister's Office announced that the US government has agreed to Iraq's request for an exemption to allow 40 daily flights of Iranian airlines to Najaf International Airport. Mahan Airlines is not included in this exemption. This decision will facilitate travel between Iran and Iraq.

Two Mexican female comedians who identify as leftists met and had lunch with Abolfazl Pasandideh, the Iranian ambassador in Mexico. They discussed war, culture, hope, and love during the meeting. This meeting was shared on their Instagram page.

On Wednesday, 8 Mehr 1405, the execution of a prisoner named Hossein Ali Baranzehi was carried out in Gorgan prison. The prisoner had been sentenced to death for murder. He was 51 years old and a father of three children.

A video has been released showing the distress of Alireza Seydi's father after selling his son's house. Alireza Seydi was a 16-year-old teenager who was killed on January 7, 2026, in the city of Qods. The video depicts the father's farewell to his son's house.

The sexual assault complaint case of a former Cornell University student has become news again. The governor of New York has appointed the state's attorney general as a special prosecutor to investigate the case. This action was taken following increased criticism of the initial handling of the case.

Reza Alipour, the silver medalist in sport climbing at the 2026 Nagoya Asian Games, protested the non-broadcast of his competitions by IRIB. He stated that IRIB broadcasts other competitions but does not show his events. He shared this protest in a video on Instagram.

Alireza Arafi, the Friday prayer leader of Qom, called the meeting between the UAE president and Netanyahu a betrayal and said this act will be recorded in files. He also described the US and Israel as ugly and vile and criticized the betrayal of some regional countries. Arafi emphasized that Muslim nations will hold these actions accountable one day.

The English Football Association announced it will review the verdict and its consequences regarding Manchester City's financial regulation breach. Manchester City has officially appealed the verdict, calling it fundamentally flawed. The club claims that the funding for major sponsorship contracts came from the Abu Dhabi government.

The Syrian presidential advisor stated that reports of contact between Damascus and Hezbollah in Lebanon are completely false. The Syrian government negotiates with Lebanon only through the Lebanese government. He also said the era of militias is over and Syria supports the Lebanese government.

Ahed Shokouhian, a prisoner sentenced to death, is held in Qezel Hesar prison in Karaj. His death sentence was confirmed at the final appeal stage, but the case was returned to Varamin investigation due to deficiencies in the investigation. This deficiency is procedural and has not led to a change in the sentence so far.
A citizen sent a video showing a broken iron lamp post in Pardisan Park, Tehran. He stated that the lamp post fell in an area where people walk. This incident has raised safety concerns in the park.

Residents of Chenasak village in Qazvin province held a Mehregan celebration with dancing on the grave of Safoura Jafari. Safoura Jafari was a 22-year-old student who was killed on January 8, 2026, in Qazvin. The ceremony took place on Thursday, September 30.

The death sentences of two prisoners were carried out on the 6th and 8th of Mehr in the prisons of Rafsanjan and Tabriz. These individuals were sentenced to death for intentional murder and drug-related crimes. The executions were carried out in separate cases.

Zinedine Zidane will sit on the bench as the head coach of France for the first time tonight against Italy in the UEFA Nations League. This match marks a special return for Zidane to the stadium where he won the 1998 World Cup. All tickets for the match were sold out in less than 24 hours.
Signs have been observed in Washington and Jerusalem. A question has been raised about when Trump will decide to restart the operation. This topic was discussed on Iran International.

Contracted firefighters in Shush report that their job titles have not been correctly recorded in insurance records. This issue has deprived them of benefits related to hard and hazardous jobs and early retirement. They have worked for years in firefighting and rescue operations.

Hossein Hosseini Karnami, the Friday prayer leader of Sari, said if the airport in this city is closed, no airport in the region will remain open. He also emphasized that the Strait of Hormuz will not be opened or closed by money or foreign support, but by internal resistance. The prayer leader also stated that the Storm of Al-Aqsa operation had significant achievements.

Abbas Goudarzi, spokesperson of the parliament's presidium, stated that Iran's armed forces are fully prepared for any military conflict and have no limitations in their defense capabilities. He warned that any country allowing its territory to be used by the US and Israel for attacks against Iran will face severe consequences. Goudarzi also mentioned that Iran has many undisclosed options for defense.

Forty-six countries signed a joint statement at the UN Human Rights Council condemning the continued use of the death penalty in Iran. They called for an immediate halt to executions and expressed concern over secret trials and torture. The statement noted that at least 31 protesters were executed after the January crackdown, with dozens more at risk of execution.

The collapse of a two-story residential building under construction in the village of Paeen-Kuh, Zanjan, caused the death of one worker and injury to another. The incident occurred due to lack of safety measures and poor working conditions. The safety situation at the workplace has been criticized.

Mehdi Kharatian warned about the dangers of the Islamic Republic yielding in Bab al-Mandeb. He attributed this trend to the UAE lobby and called for a logical escalation of tensions and cooperation with Beijing and Moscow. According to him, otherwise, the Islamic Republic will suffer losses.

A video from the mother of Aras Soleimanian shows his last birthday celebration. Aras Soleimanian was 27 years old and was killed on January 8, 2026, in Chalus city due to gunfire from government forces.

The spokesperson of the Football Federation announced changes in the coaching staff and player lineup of Iran's national football team. Ghalenoei has accepted criticisms and reforms are underway to present a different team in the November competitions. Additionally, negotiations for the under-23 team coach are ongoing, with a decision expected within 48 hours.

Last week, reports were published about wildlife deaths, prosecution of illegal hunting and wood smuggling suspects, air and water pollution, water shortages, land subsidence expansion, and pasture fires. Statistics were also announced regarding the continuation of environmental crises over longer periods. These reports highlight the connection between the right to life and citizens' health with having a healthy environment.

Hamzeh Darvish, a Sunni prisoner, was transferred from Lakaan prison in Rasht to an unknown location on Saturday, October 4. His family remains unaware of his whereabouts and condition after seven days. Their efforts to find his location have so far been unsuccessful.
The third US aircraft carrier has been deployed to the Middle East. This news was announced in the audio version of the program 24 with Fardad Farahzad. More details are provided in this program.

Two Iranian nationals in the UK have been accused of preparing terrorist acts against the Jewish community in Manchester. They were arrested on September 20 by counter-terrorism police. Investigations indicate the plan was scheduled before the Yom Kippur ceremony and involved contact with a person possibly in Iran.

The national teams of France and Italy drew 1-1 in the third week of the UEFA Nations League. Goals were scored by Michael Olise for France and Alessandro Bastoni for Italy. France played with ten men from the 85th minute.

A birthday celebration for Mehran Basir Tavana, a protester killed during the Mahsa uprising, was held at his gravesite. This 29-year-old was shot by government forces on November 16, 2022, and died three days later. A video of the ceremony has been released.

The US and 55 other countries in the Non-Proliferation Security Initiative announced they will continue enforcing UN restrictions on the Islamic Republic. These restrictions aim to prevent the transfer of sensitive nuclear materials and technologies and the construction of weapons of mass destruction. They urged the Islamic Republic to return to non-proliferation commitments and cooperate with the International Atomic Energy Agency.

Jamshid Barzegar said that statements by Friday prayer leaders and military commanders about readiness to confront opponents indicate concern about the possible resumption of nationwide protests. He identified economic crises and livelihood pressures as factors increasing dissatisfaction. The government is trying to control a new wave of protests by strengthening repression forces.

The national football team has been performing worse each day after Amir Ghalenoei was appointed head coach following the 2022 World Cup. The coaching staff has promised progress but does not allow criticism from the media. This issue was discussed in the Hattrick program.

The Iranian national football team played two friendly matches in the September FIFA window and lost both to Uzbekistan and Russia. Amir Ghalenoei, the team's coach, has promised changes. Additionally, few teams are willing to play friendly matches with Iran.
A video shows a student tearing images of Ruhollah Khomeini from their textbooks. The student wrote "Long live the Shah" on their books. This video was sent to Iran International.

Meysam Mehrani stated that the increase of American forces and naval groups in the region indicates Washington's readiness for a military option. He added that the Islamic Republic has raised its threat level due to reduced capabilities and loss of leverage such as the Strait of Hormuz. Additionally, the shift in power balance and greater regional cooperation with the US and Israel have limited the Islamic Republic's options.

Farzin Nadimi stated that the US has deployed a new carrier group and destroyers equipped with the Aegis system to the region. He added that the Islamic Republic can damage oil and gas infrastructure in the region but such attacks will not change the war equation. There is also a possibility of activation of networks affiliated with the Islamic Republic outside the region if the conflict escalates.

Kambiz Tavana said that if Saudi Arabia launches a new operation in Yemen in response to Houthi attacks, it may consider a ground presence. This move could lead to higher costs and casualties and change regional dynamics. It would also affect the energy market and the future of the Bab al-Mandab Strait.

Amnesty International has confirmed the unlawful killing of 377 people, including dozens of children, by the Islamic Republic forces. The report includes human rights violations. The organization has called for accountability of the responsible parties.

The Israeli Prime Minister stated that initial evidence suggests the Omani co-pilot of the Flydubai flight was influenced by Islamist extremism and intended to bring down the plane. Investigations have begun, with Washington also involved. The impact of this incident on regional security is under review.

Nikki Haley, former US ambassador to the UN, wrote on X about the US war with the Islamic Republic, stating that the only way to end the war is to continue maximum pressure. She noted the collapse of Iran's currency value and the resumption of oil flow. Haley added that the defeat of Iran's government would benefit Israel and Gulf allies while harming China and Russia.

The match between Iran and Russia was one of the worst performances of the national team under Amir Ghalenoei. The head coach had said before the game that the team would play differently, but this did not happen. This was discussed in an interview with Mazdak Mirzaei.

An Omani co-pilot accused of attacking the Flydubai pilot stated he intended to bring down the plane over Israeli territory. The suspect was transferred from Saudi Arabia to the UAE and is cooperating with investigators. Flydubai has temporarily suspended its flights to Tel Aviv.

Ghassan Ashour said the US exemption for Iran flights to Najaf is mainly due to Iraq's considerations, and Mahan Airlines is excluded from this exemption. Groups close to the Islamic Republic have pressured Iraq to obtain this exemption. The Iraqi prime minister is using this issue to negotiate with Tehran and Washington.

Shahram Khaledi said that mobilizing over 100,000 Yemeni forces does not mean simultaneous operations but indicates phased operations. He added that the Houthis' threat against Pakistan could weaken Islamabad's role as a mediator. There is also a possibility of the conflict expanding to the northern Indian Ocean.

Donald Trump spoke in Alabama about military strikes on Iran and criticized the media. He emphasized that Iran has lost several rounds of its leaders and no one is willing to lead. Trump added that he does not know who to negotiate with in Iran because there is no leadership.

Canada and the European Union plan to connect their new generation payment systems to facilitate cross-border transactions. This initiative is part of the new partnership called 'Alliance for the Future.' Its goal is to modernize settlement and instant payment infrastructures and reduce investment barriers.

Donald Trump said that the Islamic Republic will never acquire nuclear weapons after the war ends. He added that Iran's navy and air force have been lost and its economy has collapsed. Trump also predicted that oil prices will rapidly decrease after the elections.

Donald Trump stated that after recent attacks, the Islamic Republic has lost its navy, ships, air force, and some of its leaders. He said officials are trying to appoint new leaders but no one is willing to take responsibility. Trump added that the US does not know who to negotiate with in Iran and that the war will end soon.

Donald Trump said that Iran has lost its navy, ships, air force, and part of its leaders during attacks over the past few months. He added that Iranian authorities are seeking new officials but no one is willing to take responsibility. Trump also said the US problem is not knowing whom to talk to and reach an agreement with in Iran, but this war will end 'soon' in one way or another.

Alireza Namvar Haghighi stated that negotiators with the Islamic Republic do not have final authority and agreements may face opposition in Tehran. He added that decision-making in the Islamic Republic's power structure has become more difficult after the recent war. Washington and Tehran are trying to buy time ahead of the US midterm elections, but tensions have increased.

Mohammad Ghaedi, a lecturer in international relations, said the statement by 56 countries against the Islamic Republic attempts to link the path of reinstating UN sanctions with the US maximum pressure campaign and increase economic and security pressure on Tehran. He added that the statement could facilitate information exchange on Iran's nuclear, missile, and drone programs and inspection of related shipments. According to Ghaedi, opposition from China and Russia and China's role in supplying dual-use goods to Tehran could challenge the full implementation of this campaign.

The US and over 50 countries issued a joint statement emphasizing the continuation of UN restrictions on Iran's nuclear, missile, and arms programs. Mohammad Qaedi said the statement could link the snapback mechanism and US maximum pressure campaign. He added that opposition from China and Russia might hinder full implementation of this campaign.

Associated Press reported that US and UK leaders have suggested a possible role of the Islamic Republic in two recent security incidents, but as of October 2, this connection has not been confirmed. These incidents involve arrests near the RAF Fairford base and an attack on a Flydubai flight to Israel. The Islamic Republic has denied involvement in the Fairford incident, and investigations are still in early stages.

North Korea launched a ballistic missile toward the sea early on Saturday, October 2. This action followed North Korea's rejection of an apology request regarding border mine explosions. South Korea and Japan confirmed the launch, and South Korea's National Security Council held an emergency meeting.

A 19-meter column inspired by Persepolis has been installed in Iran Square in Buenos Aires. This column commemorates the relations between Iran and Argentina during the Pahlavi era. It was gifted following the visit of Mohammad Reza Shah Pahlavi and Empress Farah to Argentina in 1965.

Senior members of Donald Trump's administration held an unannounced meeting to discuss next steps in the war with the Islamic Republic and the Saudi conflict with the Houthis. The meeting was chaired by JD Vance and attended by senior officials. Trump is considering resuming military operations against the Islamic Republic, and Saudi Arabia has requested US participation in attacks against the Houthis.

The execution of Siavash Jamshidi was carried out on charges of waging war and conspiracy against national security. He was accused of shooting at security forces. The judiciary media described him as a thug from Shahrekord.

The team of Amir Mohammad Jamshidi and Farsad Shahi won the bronze medal in the doubles paddle competition at the 2026 Nagoya Asian Games. They defeated the team of Aria Roghani and Hami Golestan 2-0 in the third-place match. This team had lost to Malaysia in the semifinals.

Mohsen Abbasi, 21 years old, was killed by agents of the Islamic Republic during protests in Najafabad, Isfahan. A video has been released showing his father informing his injured brother about his death. This incident occurred on January 8, 2026.

Hossein Mohibi, spokesperson for the IRGC, declared the Houthis victorious against last year's US attacks. He said Donald Trump should accept Tehran's conditions. Mohibi also described artificial intelligence as the main battlefield in the war with the US.

Taxi drivers on the metro line from Enghelab to Shahrak-e Gharb are on strike due to livelihood problems and lack of passengers. Additionally, Aria Tinagen company in Aq Qala industrial town in Gorgan has not paid employees' salaries yet. The security situation in Naser Khosrow market has reduced people's presence.

Rouhollah Rahimpour stated that the Islamic Republic currently lacks the missile capability to target Europe or the United States. He said the main option for actions outside the region is the use of covert networks and terrorist operations. In this scenario, the main targets could be opponents of the Islamic Republic, opposition journalists, and Israeli nationals.

Hossein Alizadeh referred to a secret meeting of senior US officials at Camp David indicating an important decision is under review. Donald Trump is evaluating his options. The developments in Yemen and the situation in the Strait of Hormuz and Bab al-Mandab are significant in this assessment.

Mehdi Taj, head of the Football Federation, appointed Mohammad Reza Saket as the new head of the Professional Licensing Committee. Saket, former CEO of Sepahan, has been implicated in the club's financial corruption case. He replaced Mostafa Zarei in this position.

Fatemeh Ahmadi lost 2-0 to Sang Dabin from South Korea in the semifinals of the +67 kg taekwondo category at the Nagoya Asian Games and won the bronze medal. She defeated opponents from Taiwan and Saudi Arabia on her way to the semifinals.

Sirvan Shabani, a protester from Sahneh in Kermanshah province and resident of Vavan Islamshahr, has been sentenced to death on charges of moharebeh. A video of him playing the tanbur has been released on social media. He is at risk of execution of the death sentence.

Younes Emami and Amirali Azarpeira reached the final in freestyle wrestling at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games. Three Iranian taekwondo athletes secured their medals. In paddle, Amir Mohammad Jamshidi and Farsad Shahi won bronze medals.

The Judiciary Media Center announced the execution of Siavash Jamshidi Kheirabadi. He was among those arrested during the nationwide protests of December 1404 in Shahr-e Kord. His charges included waging war against God and conspiracy against national security.

Salman Es'haqi, spokesperson for the Health Commission of the Parliament, criticized the drug supply situation and rising treatment costs. He stated that over 80% of treatment costs are paid out of pocket by patients and that importing drugs from Russia and China is possible. Es'haqi also mentioned corruption in the health sector and said that patients may face death if they fall ill.
Fox News reported that the U.S. Treasury Department is discussing Turkey's air links with Iran and the risk of sanctions on related companies and financial institutions with senior Ankara officials.

Mehdi Hajimosavi lost in the final of the 68 kg taekwondo category at the 2026 Asian Games in Nagoya against Banlong Tobtimdang from Thailand. The match was held in two rounds. Hajimosavi won the silver medal.

A video from the Taekwondo Federation shows Nahid Kiani crying after losing her second match at the 2026 Asian Games in Nagoya. She is the Paris Olympic silver medalist and one of Iran's top female taekwondo gold medal hopefuls. This happened after her elimination from the competition.
A friend of Saman Yousefi sang a protest rap at his grave. The song refers to political pressures on protesters and their families. Saman Yousefi was killed on January 8 in the Tehran protests.

Mohammad Reza Naqdi, the deputy coordinator of the IRGC, commented on the possibility of a renewed US attack. He said that if the US decides based on its interests, it will not attack. He also warned that a renewed US attack would be equivalent to suicide.

Arian Salimi won the gold medal in the +80 kg taekwondo final at the 2026 Nagoya Asian Games by defeating his Uzbek opponent. He won the first set 26-4 and the second set 20-8. With this gold medal, Iran's taekwondo team finished the games with 2 golds, 1 silver, and 1 bronze.

Mansour Pourian, head of the Livestock Supply Council, denied reports of donkey and horse meat being sold, calling them psychological rumors and stating there is no official evidence. He emphasized that the meat available in the market comes only from specified livestock. He also said that severe action has been taken against those caught selling unauthorized meat.

Amir Ghalenoei invites mostly aging players on the verge of retirement to the Iranian national football team. This is despite the presence of young and motivated players in Iranian football. The issue was discussed in an interview with Mazdak Mirzaei.

A secret meeting of senior US officials was held at Camp David regarding the relationship between the Islamic Republic and the Houthis. The importance of Bab al-Mandeb for maritime security and the global supply chain was discussed. The US focuses on establishing a stable government in Yemen.

Hossein Aghaei referred to Donald Trump's remarks about an early end to the war and said if neither the US nor the Islamic Republic compromises, a new war is inevitable. He described two possible scenarios: limited attacks on specific facilities or broader attacks on infrastructure and officials. The main issue is the timing of the war's start.

Officials at the University of Medical Sciences have issued installment meat purchase vouchers for employees up to 10 million tomans. These vouchers allow repayment in installments. Previously, reports indicated a decline in purchasing power and a shift towards installment buying among citizens.

Forough Kenani stated that details of Siavash Jamshidi's case were not released before his execution. No evidence was presented showing his involvement in a murder. She added that the Islamic Republic uses executions to suppress ongoing protests.

The Attorney General of the UAE declared the attack on the Flydubai pilot as a terrorist attack and accused the co-pilot of carrying out a terrorist operation. CNN reported that the co-pilot had previously been expelled from flight training due to concerns about his extremist views. Additionally, his social media accounts contained extremist and misogynistic content.

Cristiano Ronaldo remains at the center of controversies with the Portugal national team. Former Brazilian footballer Felipe Melo criticized Ronaldo's teammates' behavior and questioned their lack of support for him. Melo also highlighted the difference in how Portuguese players treat Ronaldo compared to how Argentine players treat Messi.

The Iranian national water polo team lost 13-9 to China in the classification match of the 2026 Asian Games in Nagoya and finished fourth. Iran had also lost 12-8 to China in the group stage. Iran's last water polo medal at the Asian Games was in 2018 Jakarta.

Benjamin Netanyahu said in an interview that the Islamic Republic government will fall and the day of freedom for the Iranian people will come. He added that Trump's sanctions have weakened the Revolutionary Guards. Netanyahu also claimed that Israel has prevented Iran from obtaining nuclear weapons.

At least 13 citizens related to the Qaleh Chenan case in Ahvaz remain detained and legally uncertain after about seven months. They are held in Sheiban prison and are denied access to lawyers and family visits. The status of Amin Naseri, who was reportedly shot during a security operation, is unknown.

Mahtab Gholizadeh stated that the government and central bank have taken ineffective measures to control the currency market, which have not affected the dollar price. She also mentioned that new US Treasury sanctions have increased pressure on the rial's value. These sanctions have made foreign trade and money transfers more difficult.

Younes Emami won the 74 kg freestyle wrestling final at the 2026 Asian Games in Nagoya by defeating Soke from Japan 9-5. The victory came with an impressive comeback. This was Iran's seventeenth gold medal in Nagoya.

The Israeli Prime Minister criticized Western governments, especially the UK, for focusing their criticism on Israel while ignoring the threat of the Islamic Republic and its proxy forces. He asked protesters in the UK why they do not protest in front of the Islamic Republic's embassy. Netanyahu also accused Western governments of failing to recognize the threat posed by the Islamic Republic.

The police commander of Mahabad announced that one person was killed and four were injured in the shooting incident in front of the Mahabad courthouse. The incident occurred following a verbal dispute among several women and the arrival of an armed man. The shooter was arrested at the scene.

Student protests over teacher shortages, crowded classes, and school deterioration have been ongoing in France since Monday. More than five thousand people have been arrested so far. This report is provided by Sajedeh Sharifi from Iran International.

The 40th-day memorial ceremony for Ali Hashemi was held on Thursday, 9 Mehr 1405, in the village of Sheshjavan, Isfahan. Ali Hashemi was arrested by security forces on 25 Ordibehesht and transferred to the central prison of Isfahan. His family was informed on 28 Mordad that he was hospitalized due to cardiac arrest, but upon arrival at the hospital, they were told he had passed away.

Ali Asghar Karabi, the father of a victim of the December protests, has been detained in Sabzevar prison for 24 days and remains in legal limbo. He was summoned and arrested by a security agency after visiting his son's grave and posting a video on social media. His legal status is still unclear.

The Ministry of Intelligence announced the arrest of 31 people in Sirjan County. The charges include participation in the December 2025 protests, collaboration with the enemy, and destruction of property. These arrests were carried out by the Intelligence Department of Kerman Province.

Amirali Azarpira defeated his Uzbek opponent 10-0 in the 97 kg freestyle wrestling final at the 2026 Asian Games in Nagoya. He won the gold medal in this event. This was the 18th gold medal for the Iranian team and the last medal for the wrestling team in these games.

Mohammad Amin Mandani, a prisoner held in Tehran's central prison, was sentenced to death and 20 years in prison by Branch 26 of the Tehran Revolutionary Court. His charges include cooperating with hostile states and gathering and conspiring against national security. The sentence was issued by Judge Iman Afshari.

The Yemeni government forces carried out airstrikes on areas controlled by the Houthis in Sana'a. These attacks occurred on Saturday, 11 Mehr, and smoke was seen in the city's sky. The Houthis are supported by the Islamic Republic.

The mother of Moein Abbaspour responded to Masoud Pezeshkian's claim that her son was a terrorist by questioning why the Islamic Republic's Martyrs Foundation approached their family to declare him a martyr. This reaction was seen in a video released on social media. The issue arose during Pezeshkian's trip to the United States.

Hamid Kouhsari, a 31-year-old protester, said he was shot in the leg by security forces during the December 2025 protests in Gorgan. He reported direct shooting by security forces at protesters and the killing and wounding of citizens. Kouhsari also spoke about living in hiding for eight months before leaving Iran.

The head of the Automotive Parts Manufacturers Association stated that sanctions and transportation issues have increased costs. Additionally, liquidity problems and the need for loans have risen due to inflation and price increases. He called for at least a 100% increase in loans to secure raw materials.

A group of Iranians gathered in Stockholm for the tenth consecutive month in protest. Participants held pictures of the deceased and commemorated them. They called for global attention to developments in Iran.
